description: kithd/src/identity_dev.rs is gated behind #[cfg(any(test, feature = 'test-utils'))] (confirmed in kithd/src/lib.rs:25-26). The DevIdentityProvider authenticates every inbound connection as a fixed, hardcoded identity with no actual verification. This is correct for test isolation, but the test-utils feature flag means it can be compiled into any binary that enables that feature — including an accidentally mis-configured production build. The test-utils feature should be documented as 'must never be enabled in production' and ideally enforced via a compile-time cfg check that emits a warning or error when compiled without the test profile. Consider adding a #[cfg(not(feature = 'production'))] guard or a doc comment on the feature in Cargo.toml that explicitly states this is a security boundary.
title: DevIdentityProvider accessible via test-utils feature flag
